definitions.explanation: Describes someone who keeps repeating the same request, action, or question in an annoying or stubborn way. Often has a negative connotation.
Describes food or flavors that are too rich, oily, or heavy, making one feel full or uncomfortable.

examples.japanese: しつこく⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{困|こま}った→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
examples.english: I was troubled by persistent questioning.

examples.japanese: しつこい⟦{勧誘|かんゆう}→勧誘：16850_kanyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{迷惑|めいわく}→迷惑：02432_meiwaku⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ちょっと→ちょっと：00595_chotto⟧しつこい。
examples.english: This dish is a bit too heavy/rich.
As you get older, you tend to dislike heavy/rich flavors.

examples.japanese: ⟦{断|ことわ}った→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧⟦のに→のに：10529_noni⟧、しつこく⟦{誘|さそ}って→誘う：01947_sasou⟧⟦くる→くる：00254_kuru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧⟦うんざり→うんざり：04829_unzari⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was fed up because they kept insistently inviting me even though I had refused.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧しつこくて⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{食|た}べられなかった→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: This ramen was so greasy that I couldn't finish it.

notes:
ADJECTIVE FORMS:
- しつこい (dictionary form)
- しつこく (adverbial form)
- しつこく⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (negative)
- しつこかった (past)
- しつこさ (noun form)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- しつこい⟦{勧誘|かんゆう}→勧誘：16850_kanyuu⟧ - persistent solicitation
- しつこい⟦セールス→セールス：11050_seerusu⟧ - pushy sales
- しつこく⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to question persistently
- しつこく⟦{付|つ}きまとう→付きまとう：10379_tsukimatou⟧ - to persistently follow/stalk

FOOD CONTEXT:
- しつこい⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧ - heavy/rich taste
- ⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧しつこい - greasy, oily
- しつこく⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧/⟦あっさり→あっさり：05650_assari⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧ - light, refreshing (antonym)

NUANCE: When describing people's behavior, しつこい is typically negative, implying annoyance. However, in some contexts it can suggest tenacity in a neutral way.

SYNONYMS/RELATED:
- ⟦{執拗|しつよう}→執拗：08672_shitsuyou⟧ - persistent (more formal)
- ⟦くどい→くどい：10318_kudoi⟧ - repetitive, long-winded
- ⟦あっさり→あっさり：05650_assari⟧ - light (antonym for taste)
